name: player_tick_active_camera_state
description: Player::TickActiveCameraState drives the active per-player camera state, maintains the per-tick camera variant/weather updates, and caches the direction basis for the next frame.
known_limits: Binary Ninja disassembly/HLIL for 0x404e90 validates unconditional g_Player_CameraVariantUpdatedThisTick reset, optional g_Player_RebuildCameraDirFlatFromCurrentTarget processing, gwCameraGetTarget, Vec3DeltaLength before applying cameraYOffset, full vector normalization into cameraDirFlat, switch dispatch for camera states 1 through 7, fallback UpdateCameraVariantFromCameraPos when the variant flag remains clear, unconditional UpdateCameraWeatherFxEmitterVisibility, and cameraBasisCache selection from steerBasisNorm only for state 2.

The native smoke verifies the rebuild path, state-5 no-op dispatch path, default variant update path, weather null-emitter path, cameraDirNext cache path, and state-2 steerBasisNorm cache path; individual state updater bodies are covered by their own functional targets.
No VC object-byte manifest covers 0x404e90 yet, so tier S verification is deferred to a coherent Player camera/source-cluster pass.
